title: Entity
description: A clearance-relevant thing named in the script. One Parallel research task per entity.

surface.description: Exact text as written in the script.

context.description: The sentence(s) around it. What the researcher actually needs.

depicted_negatively.description: Load-bearing. Flips a brand from 'send a courtesy letter' to 'will never clear'.

portrayal.description: PERSON entities only: how the script's own scenes portray this real person. Invented dialogue or scenes making a real person look foolish, cruel, dishonest, or contemptible is 'unflattering' even when brief; depiction as committing crimes or fraud is 'criminal_or_fraudulent'.
